part: Tube splice: one U channel and one top plate that hold two pieces of the square tube end to end. A tongue on the plate reaches between the U's arms and presses on the tube.
profile: Cross-section from enclosure.json (tube and clamp sections): the fit-tested U1 pocket (18.9 mm) and arms, with the M2.5 clearance holes, captured-nut slots and head recesses of US-NECK-MOUNT-R010. base and plate below replace the clamp's 4 mm base and 6 mm bar, and the arms rise by the tongue's height.

notes.grip: Length of U that holds each tube piece; the U is twice this long and the tube ends meet at its middle. 35 mm (30 mm on R002) makes the splice 70 mm long. The pocket's 0.3 to 0.9 mm of sideways play then lets a piece rock at most 0.5 to 1.5 degrees before the arms stop it.
notes.base: Thickness of the U behind the tube: twice the neck clamp's 4 mm, because the joint flexes.
notes.plate: Thickness of the one top plate outside its tongue. The plate covers both tube pieces and has a screw at each corner. It is 2 mm more than the neck clamp's bar, because it spans the joint between its screws.
notes.tongue: Height of the rib on the plate's tube face. The rib runs the plate's length between the arms and bears on both tube pieces. The arms rise by the same height, so they stand past the largest tube's front face, and the plate still clears them by the clamp's takeup_min (1 mm) on the smallest tube.
notes.tongue_clearance: Gap each side between the tongue and the arms: 0.3 mm, where Prusa's guide starts moving fits. The tongue is 18.3 mm wide in the 18.9 mm pocket.
notes.under_head: Plate left under each screw head, as on the neck clamp's bar (6 - 2.7 mm). The head recesses are plate - under_head deep, so the heads sit where they do on the neck clamp and the same screw length fits.
notes.hole_end_below_pocket: The blind screw holes end this far below the pocket floor, as on R002, so the thicker base stays solid under them.
notes.row_inset: The four screws sit this far from the U's ends, one at each corner of the plate.
notes.screw: M2.5 socket-head screw length, checked against the clamp's screw window.
